subject: Insurance
title: Gap Insurance
description: A quick win: understand Gap Insurance.

hook.text: You owe $25,000 on your car loan, but the car is worth $18,000. If it's totaled, insurance pays $18,000.

buildup.text: Cars depreciate 20-30% in the first year. Your loan balance drops slower.

discovery.text: Gap insurance is especially important for low down payments, long loan terms.

twist.text: Dealers charge $500-1,000 for gap insurance at signing. The same coverage from your insurer costs $20-50 a year.

climax.text: Gap insurance solves a specific problem: being underwater on a car loan.

quiz.question: When is gap insurance most important?
options: When the car is paid off
When the loan balance exceeds the car's market value
